what_changed: PO-7781 (400 MC-500 controllers, originally all arriving on day 5) is now split: 120 arrive on day 5 and the remaining 280 arrive on day 26.
decisions_for_a_person: Whether to take up Karen Walsh's offer to discuss other options this week, for example asking whether more controllers can arrive earlier than day 26. Under the split, 90 bikes across O-1043, O-1044 and O-1045 ship late. O-1043 (City of Ashford Bike Share) is 10 bikes short, is 12 days late and carries a late penalty.
Whether and how much to tell the supplier about which customers are affected, since she asked for that and it is customer information.
How to handle the late shipments with City of Ashford Bike Share (O-1043, penalty applies), Main Street Bikes (O-1044) and Lakeview Rentals (O-1045).
supplier_questions: Which of Brookfield's customers are most affected, so the supplier can understand the impact on Brookfield's side?
